mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements about AMRUT: 1. It initially covered 500 cities, which became 485 after 15 were merged. 2. It covers about 60% of India's urban population. 3. Its total outlay was Rs 1 lakh crore, of which the central share was Rs 75,000 crore. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
mcq_fix.why: y3641efaabff keys AMRUT coverage as 60% of urban population

patterns: APPSC asks current-affairs style facts: cleanest city (Indore), GHTC full form, World Cities Day theme, UIDF statements (only III valid).
AMRUT mission-city questions ('which city is not a mission city', Dausa) and JNNURM scope (63 million-plus cities).
Other PSCs: AMRUT thrust areas, coverage 60%, HRIDAY odd-one-out (Agra), chronology JNNURM -> NUHHP -> AMRUT -> JJM.
App covers the schemes thoroughly with statement sets; a few opinion/criticism items and recent AP funding figures go beyond PYQ style.
